## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short two-fascicle work by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) presenting selected critical issues from [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* in question-and-answer format. The "*liào jiǎn*" 料簡 ("critical selection / sifting of materials") title indicates a focused doctrinal-critical study of disputed points, complementing the more general [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì* and [KR6n0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0029) *zhǎngzhōng shūyào*. Preserved only in the *Xuzangjing* (X48n0806) and not in the Taishō.

**Abstract**

The text is one of two short works by [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) preserved in the *Xuzangjing* but not in the Taishō — the other being [KR6n0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0034) *Chéng wéishí lùn bié chāo* 成唯識論別抄 (X48n0808). Both preserve material that did not enter the great commentaries (the *shùjì* and the lost full *shū*) but that Kuījī treated as worth recording for circulation. The dating bracket (659–682) follows from his teaching career at Cí'ēnsì.

The *liàojiǎn* and *biéchāo* together constitute the principal source for our understanding of how Kuījī conceived of the doctrinal cruces of the *Chéng wéishí lùn* outside the systematic commentary. Several positions taken in these works are at variance with — or substantially developed beyond — the corresponding passages in the *shùjì*, providing important evidence for the development of Kuījī's mature thought.
